resources.string: Keep a root-managed tailnet overlay online while another Android VPN app owns the VPN slot.
Root overlay · VPN coexistence · remote ADB
Preferred low-risk mode for remote ADB and MCP. It uses no Android VPN slot and writes no kernel route.
Forwards tailnet TCP 5555 to local ADB and, when present, TCP 8765 to the local MCP relay. Other phone traffic is unchanged.
Enable Root TCP ADB on port 5555 in ADB Control Center first.
Only tailnet traffic is routed into tailscale0. Normal Internet traffic remains under Android / Hiddify.
Enable a real root TUN instead of Android VpnService. DNS acceptance stays disabled to avoid proxy/VPN DNS conflicts.
This restarts the managed daemon with tailscale0 and lets Tailscale install its native Linux route and firewall rules. Keep USB recovery connected for the first validation.
The root tailnet address and remote ADB path will disappear until the overlay is enabled again. Authentication state is preserved.
Authentication is one-time and stored in the root-owned Tailscale state file.
Connect this root node to your tailnet
RootTools starts tailscaled in userspace mode, obtains the official Tailscale login URL, and opens the system browser. RootTools never receives your Google/Microsoft/GitHub password.
Android VpnService stays available for Hiddify or another proxy VPN; Tailscale uses root Linux networking instead.
Hiddify owns Android VPN while Root Tailscale is independently ready. This is the target coexistence state.
Root Tailscale is verified. The official Tailscale Android VPN can now be stopped safely to release the VPN slot.
The official Tailscale Android app still owns the VPN slot. Authenticate and enable the root overlay before releasing it.
Another Android VPN is active while Root Tailscale is independently ready. This is the target coexistence state.
Another Android VPN is active. Finish and verify a Root Tailscale management mode before relying on both paths.
Root Tailscale is ready and the Android VPN slot is available for another VPN app.
Enable and verify the root overlay before using simultaneous VPN coexistence.
RootTools will stop only the official Tailscale Android app. Confirm that a trusted tailnet peer can already reach this phone; the root-managed mode will remain running.
Privileged network runtimes are pinned and hash-verified instead of downloading an unverified latest build.
Downloads the official stable archive, verifies its fixed SHA-256, extracts only tailscale/tailscaled, then installs them atomically under /data/adb/tailscale.
Explicit opt-in only. No infinite retry loop is installed.
Installs one RootTools-owned Magisk service.d script for the currently verified mode. It uses bounded waits and never stops another VPN app.
This writes /data/adb/service.d/99-roottools-tailscale.sh. The script is removable from this same switch and does not modify other Magisk service scripts.
RootTools will remove only its own Root Tailscale service.d script. The currently running overlay is not stopped.
Read-back checks for the root runtime and remote ADB path.
Root is unavailable, so Root Tailscale cannot change Linux networking.
Install the verified Root Tailscale runtime first.
